Das OEG ist seit dem 1. Januar 2024 im S.en: Since 1 January 2024, the Victim Compensation Act (Opferentschädigungsgesetz, OEG) has been incorporated into Book XIV of the Social Code (SGB XIV). What this means for ongoing proceedings and old decisions.

Das OEG gibt es so nicht mehr.en: The OEG no longer exists in this form

Das Opferentschädigungsgesetz wurde zum.en: With effect from 1 January 2024, the Victim Compensation Act (Opferentschädigungsgesetz) was replaced by Book XIV of the Social Code (Vierzehntes Buch Sozialgesetzbuch, SGB XIV). Since then, this area has been called social compensation law (Soziales Entschädigungsrecht), and all new applications go through it.

Der Begriff „OEG\" ist trotzdem gebliebe.en: Even so, the term “OEG” has stuck — in official decisions, at advice centres and in people’s minds. Anyone who knows it will also search for it. That is why this page explains what it still means today.

Wann das alte Recht noch gilt.en: When the old law still applies

Für Anträge, die vor dem 1. Januar 2024.en: Applications made before 1 January 2024 continue to be assessed under the OEG. So an ongoing procedure does not switch its legal basis halfway through.

Wer vor 2024 bereits Leistungen bezogen.en: Anyone who was already receiving benefits before 2024 was automatically transferred to the new law. The decisions remain valid, the payments continued without interruption, and no new application was needed for this.

Ein Blick auf den alten Bescheid kann si.en: It can be worth taking a look at your old decision

Das SGB XIV kennt Leistungen, die es im.en: SGB XIV provides benefits that did not exist under the OEG — above all the trauma outpatient clinic (Traumaambulanz). If you have an old decision, you should have someone check whether the new services could apply to you.

Zusammengetragen am 22. September 2026 a.en: Compiled on 22 September 2026 from the official source. The legal position and responsibilities change — if in doubt, the source applies, not this page.

Entschädigung nach einer Gewalttat: Wer.en: Compensation after an act of violence: who is entitled, what the trauma outpatient clinic (Traumaambulanz) provides and how the application works.

Wer durch eine Gewalttat gesundheitliche.en: Anyone who has suffered damage to their health as a result of an act of violence can receive social compensation benefits (Leistungen der Sozialen Entschädigung). Since 1 January 2024, this has been governed by Book XIV of the Social Code (SGB XIV), which replaced the Victim Compensation Act (Opferentschädigungsgesetz).

Der Gedanke dahinter: Der Staat konnte d.en: The idea behind it: the state was unable to prevent the crime and therefore takes responsibility for its consequences. This is not about damages from the perpetrator — that route remains unaffected.

Das ist die wichtigste Neuerung gegenübe.en: This is the most important change compared with the OEG. The old law required a physical assault (tätlicher Angriff) — that is, physical violence. Der Grad der Behinderung beschreibt, wie.en: The degree of disability (Grad der Behinderung) describes how strongly health impairments affect participation in life in society. It is determined in steps of ten from 20 to 100.

Ab einem GdB von 50 gilt man als schwerb.en: With a GdB of 50 or more, you are considered severely disabled and receive a severe disability card (Schwerbehindertenausweis). Compensatory entitlements (Nachteilsausgleiche) are linked to it — from protection against dismissal to tax allowances.

Der GdB ist kein Prozentwert und keine A.en: The GdB is not a percentage and says nothing about a person’s worth. It is an administrative measure to which rights are attached.

Beantragt wird die Feststellung, nicht d.en: What you apply for is the determination, not the card

Das klingt nach Wortklauberei, ist aber.en: This sounds like splitting hairs, but it is the core of the procedure: at the pension office (Versorgungsamt), you apply for a determination of disability under Section 152 of Book IX of the Social Code (§ 152 SGB IX). The card only follows if the result is a GdB of at least 50.

Das Amt fordert die Befunde bei den beha.en: The office requests the medical findings from your treating doctors and assesses them according to the Principles of Medical Care (Versorgungsmedizinische Grundsätze). A personal examination usually does not take place.

Die Bearbeitung dauert je nach Bundeslan.en: Processing usually takes two to six months, depending on the federal state and the case. The determination applies retroactively to the month in which the application was made — so applying early is never a mistake.

Anonymisierte, bundeslandspezifische Aus.en: Anonymised, state-by-state analysis of shortcomings & best practices

Ziel: Wir erfassen anonymisiert und bund.en: Aim: We record, anonymously and state by state, structural shortcomings as well as best practices in how social compensation law (Soziales Entschädigungsrecht, SER; formerly the Crime Victims Compensation Act, OEG, now Book XIV of the Social Code, SGB XIV) is applied. From deadlines to expert reports – the focus is on patterns that point to systemic problems. Important: this is not about advice on individual cases, but about systematically documenting structures.

Wirkung & Adressaten: Die gebündelten Er.en: Impact & audience: The combined findings are passed on specifically to victims' commissioners (Opferbeauftragte), the heads of the state offices (Landesämter) and the relevant federal ministries – with the aim of prompting concrete improvements and promoting best practices.

AG 02 – Informationsfreiheitsgesetz (IFG.en: AG 02 – Freedom of Information Act (IFG) vs. open questions

Entwicklung eines Fragenkatalogs für die.en: Developing a set of questions for the state offices on administrative practice

Ziel: Im Zentrum steht ein systematisch.en: Aim: At the centre is a systematically developed set of questions to the state offices (Landesämter) about how OEG/SGB XIV procedures are implemented in the federal states, how they run and how transparent they are. A lawyer sends the questions to the relevant state offices under the Freedom of Information Act (Informationsfreiheitsgesetz, IFG), in order to obtain comparable information and gain a realistic overview of actual administrative practice. The results feed into working group no. 1, “SER (OEG/SGB XIV) vs. shortcomings & best practice”. This is explicitly not about advice on individual cases. We collect structural data in order to improve how the law is applied in the long term and to make targeted political influence possible.

Gewalt gegen Frauen, Mädchen und alle vo.en: Violence against women, girls and everyone affected by gender-based violence is not an isolated case – it is a structural problem. The Istanbul Convention is the strongest international instrument of protection, designed to keep those affected from being overlooked, unheard or left alone.

Als KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. erkennen wir di.en: As KE!N EINZELFALL e.V., we expressly recognise the Istanbul Convention and see its principles as a central guide for our work. Mit unserer öffentlichen Unterstützung d.en: By publicly supporting the Istanbul Convention, we make it clear: those affected deserve protection, respect, safety and reliable support structures. We are committed to making gaps in the support system visible and filling them wherever state services are still missing or inadequate.
